ukraine is hitting deeper into russia.
putin is threatening “systemic strikes” on kyiv.
and the risk of escalation is going up.
@gzeromedia

Video

talking with @tedtalks about how to make sense of the relentless news cycle. no doomscrolling necessary.

no regime change in iran, no handpicking of the next supreme leader.

no dismantling of iran’s proxies, no restrictions on its ballistic missile and drone programs. 

an agreement to downblend the highly enriched uranium inside iran.

the destruction of iran’s navy, but an emboldened iran that is prepared to disrupt the strait. 

throw in the cost in lives, the global economy, and the global treasure, and the reputational damage to the united states…and president trump has some serious explainin

quite some cheek, the russians telling us/nato to evacuate kyiv. 

good luck with that.

significant additional climbdown in war goals from president trump. 

iranian leaders have to be pleased with the progress on their “how about nothing” negotiating efforts.
a few folks really don’t want an iran deal
iran: what if instead of tolls we call them revenue enhancements?

rule of don: the trump administration decision to settle a lawsuit the trump administration brought against the trump administration to create a $1.8 billion trump administration "weaponization fund" to pay those the trump administration deems unfairly prosecuted.
chances of saudi arabia joining abraham accords given present israel policy in gaza (called a genocide by mbs) & west bank: pretty much zero

is the deal dead?
is it alive? 
no way of knowing for sure until the final tweet.
probably the camp david accords. good friday agreement, inf treaty, german reunification right up there.

bonus round

5) runner starting on 2nd in extra innings (what sort of bullshit is this)
6) almond milk 
7) peeps (except for exploding in microwaves, this is acceptable usage)
8) electric scooters
losing a war in six months is a lot better than losing a war in twenty years.

things we could do without:
1) baby yoda 
2) pickleball
3) cats
4) rhode island statehood

if trump’s highest priority now is ending the war he started, best move is define in purely unilateral terms: “the war is over in 2-3 weeks, “i already won,” “i don’t care if talks succeed or fail.”

challenge: gives iran very little incentive to concede anything.
